title: Decoded messages of aliens with a dying planet needing Earth women

tellings.quote: just that there were aliens from another planet. They were here. They were trying to establish a base. They needed Earth women or something.

plain: In Albuquerque, New Mexico, in the early 1980s, a man named Paul Bennewitz believed he had decoded messages showing that aliens from another planet were here, trying to set up a base, and that "they needed Earth women or something." The researcher Greg Bishop, who has studied Bennewitz's case, recounts what Bennewitz came to believe, and he tells it as part of the story of how the belief took over Bennewitz's mind.
